title: PCR Preparation with Frozen Aluminum Block
author: Opentrons
materials: Samples + mastermix are mixed as specified.

steps.title: Freeze block with mastermix
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons 24‑tube aluminum block that holds the mastermix in a freezer before starting the run so the mastermix stays cold.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the protocol with the following required parameters: Number of Columns; Source Plate Starting Column; Destination Plate Starting Column; Sample Volume (µL); Mastermix Volume (µL); Source Aspiration Height (Plate) (mm); Source Aspiration Height (Tube) (mm); Source Aspiration Flow Rate Sample (µL/sec); Delay After Aspiration Mastermix (seconds); Source Aspiration Flow Rate Mastermix (µL/sec); Dispense Height (mm) from bottom of destination well; Dispense Flow Rate Sample; Dispense Flow Rate Mastermix; Mix Repetitions; Touch Tip? (yes/no); Blowout? (yes/no); P20 Single‑channel Mount (left or right); P20 Multi‑channel Mount (left or right).

steps.title: Add mastermix to plate
steps.instruction: Using the single‑channel P20 pipette (mounted as specified), aspirate the defined mastermix volume from each tube at the specified tube aspiration height and flow rate, optionally wait the defined delay after aspiration, then dispense into the destination wells of the 96‑well plate at the defined dispense height and flow rate, covering the number of columns indicated.

steps.title: Add samples to plate
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel P20 pipette (mounted as specified), aspirate the defined sample volume from the source plate at the specified plate aspiration height and flow rate, then dispense into the corresponding wells of the destination plate at the defined dispense height and flow rate, covering the number of columns indicated.

steps.title: Mix samples and mastermix
steps.instruction: Perform the specified number of mix repetitions in each well using the defined mix settings (touch tip, blowout, mix flow rates) to thoroughly combine the sample and mastermix.
